newsitem.title: USA: Arkwright and Liberty Mutual form alliance.
newsitem.headline: Arkwright and Liberty Mutual form alliance.

text.p: Arkwright Mutual Insurance Co and Liberty Mutual Group have formed a strategic alliance to offer commercial property coverage.
Arkwright Mutual said it created ALM Services Inc, a wholly owned unit to provide risk assessment, loss prevention engineering, claims management and supporting information services.
Liberty Mutual said it will sell the ALM program through its existing sales force and national network of commercial insurance offices.
Arkwright said ALM is expected to be fully functional by July 1, operating under the direction of Wolfgang F. Friedel, president and chief executive officer.

"Having access to Arkwright's world-renowned property engineering and loss prevention expertise will help our customers better define existing property risk and either mitigate or eliminate it," said Gary L. Countryman, Liberty Mutual chairman and chief executive officer.
"Combined with our expertise in casualty insurance, our customers will have the best property and casualty insurance programs offered in the United States."
William J. Poutsiaka, Arkwright's president and chief executive said the alliance will build on the respective strengths of each company.

"Unlike more common arrangements limited to an occasional marketing of joint (property) coverage, the breadth of our agreement and our mutual enthusiasm establish the basis for a meaningful sharing of knowledge, resources and capacity.
"We believe the outcome will be the most advanced property capability, ultimately benefiting the customers and employees of both firms," he said.
